findings.title: Telnet (23) open on 192.168.1.20
findings.detail: Port 23/tcp is reachable. Unauthenticated cleartext shell. Disable immediately.

findings.title: SMB (445) open on 192.168.1.20
findings.detail: Port 445/tcp is reachable. SMB on a network perimeter is a prime ransomware vector.
findings.remediation: SMB on a network perimeter is a prime ransomware vector.

findings.title: Open network: Cafe Free WiFi
findings.detail: No encryption. All traffic, DNS queries and session cookies are visible to anyone in range.
findings.remediation: Use WPA3-SAE (or WPA2-AES at minimum). Never use an open network for sensitive traffic.

findings.title: WEP is broken: Legacy-WEP
findings.detail: WEP's RC4 IV can be recovered from a few minutes of traffic; the key falls trivially.
findings.remediation: Replace the AP or switch to WPA2-AES/WPA3 immediately. WEP cannot be made safe.

findings.title: Open network with a randomized BSSID
findings.detail: BSSID 02:11:22:33:44:55 has the locally-administered bit set and offers no encryption.
findings.remediation: Treat as untrusted. Check for rogue DHCP/DNS before connecting.

findings.title: WPS advertised: SentinelLab-IoT
findings.detail: This AP advertises WPS support even though its primary security is WPA2.
findings.remediation: Turn off WPS in the AP configuration.

findings.title: HTTPS (443) open on 192.168.1.1
findings.detail: Port 443/tcp is reachable. Audit TLS version, cipher suites and certificate validity.
findings.remediation: Audit TLS version, cipher suites and certificate validity.

findings.title: HTTP (80) open on 192.168.1.1
findings.detail: Port 80/tcp is reachable. Prefer HTTPS with HSTS; check for default admin pages.
findings.remediation: Prefer HTTPS with HSTS; check for default admin pages.
